lines.text: They lost their first league game. By December 2009 they had won all six trophies.
Barcelona opened Pep Guardiola's first La Liga season with a one nil defeat at newly promoted Numancia.
Guardiola's entire coaching record was one season with Barça B, in the fourth tier of Spanish football.
Andrés Iniesta walked into Guardiola's office unprompted: 'Don't worry, everything will be fine.'
Barcelona won all six trophies they entered in a calendar year. No club had done that before.
Guardiola left Barcelona in 2012. His last match brought his 14th trophy, out of a possible 19.
Would Barcelona have hired Guardiola if he had lost his first two games before getting the job?
